# Compound meter and a short closing system

`source.musicxml` is an original synthetic flute score released under Apache-2.0.
It contains a triplet, a printed 4/4 to 6/8 change, a dotted-quarter tempo mark,
and a short final system with a single closing barline.

`page.png` was engraved with Verovio 6.3.0 and the SIL OFL Bravura font. The
engraver used encoded breaks, a 2100 × 1600 page at scale 100, and no footer.
The SVG was rasterized onto white and cropped vertically to 80 pixels of
padding around the ink. The test uses these fixed pixels across operating systems.
